title: UuError::UnexpectedEof is declared but never constructed
description: uuencoding/src/error.rs:40 declares UnexpectedEof with full doc comment claiming 'Produced when decode() reaches end of input'. But decode() and decode_limited() never return this variant — they return Ok(DecodedBlock { is_truncated: true }) instead. Callers reading the doc comment would write match arms that can never fire. Fix: either (a) remove the variant (breaking change, but it was never reachable), or (b) add a note to the doc comment that this variant is reserved for future use / not currently returned, or (c) actually use it. Option (b) is least disruptive for a published 0.1.0 crate.
close_reason: Fixed: doc comment now accurately states variant is reserved and not currently returned.
